1 20.10.2020, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 WP(C).No.30568 OF 2013(U)
 -2-  JUDGMENT Dated this the 20th day of October 2020
This writ petition was filed in the year 2013 challenging Ext.P5 notice issued by the Health Officer, Cochin Corporation.
2. It appears that the Corporation acted upon the complaint in regard to the conduct of a hotel by the petitioner.
As seen from the impugned notice, the petitioner started using the open space in front of his hotel for preparation of food.
This activity resulted in nuisance or pollution to the neighbouring owners and residents.
The Health Inspector, on inspection, found that the complaint is genuine and directed the petitioner to stop the activities being carried out by him.
Challenging this, the petitioner approached this Court.
3. The petitioner is enjoying a stay in this matter for the last several years.

In such circumstances,
this Court is of the view that if the petitioner wants to raise any objection and regularise the activities, he shall approach the Cochin WP(C).No.30568 OF 2013(U) Corporation.
This shall be done within a period of two weeks.
The interim order dated 14.10.2014, will continue in this matter until a decision is taken by the Corporation based on the objection raised by the petitioner.
It is made clear that if the petitioner fails to abate the nuisance or pollution, the Corporation is free to initiate action against him in accordance with law.
Ordered accordingly.

The writ petition is disposed of as above.
Sd/-
